name: Anna
description: Wife of Tobit, of his own kindred, mother of Tobias; took in work to support the household while Tobit was blind, and mourned Tobias as dead until his safe return

points: One of the Ninevites reported him; he fled for his life, and all his goods were forcibly taken, nothing left him beside his wife Anna and his son Tobias.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Tobit died at a hundred and fifty-eight, and after Anna died Tobias went to Ecbatane to Raguel his father-in-law, buried him and his mother-in-law honorably and inherited their substance, and his father Tobit's as well.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
